recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14169 unless BR&R later revisits ResearchStudy site semantics more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-14169 asked to change the ResearchStudy.site definition to "A facility in which study activities are conducted." The Jira issue is Published, resolved Persuasive, and records that the change was made and published in the Dec 2017 FHIR ballot.
initial_application: Git commit 61b5fa557635a9d272e7508b2c7e139a895be930 explicitly lists GF#14169 in a BR&R ResearchStudy update and changes the spreadsheet source for ResearchStudy.site from "Clinic, hospital or other healthcare location that is participating in the study" to "A facility in which study activities are conducted." Later source rework, including 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157, carried the wording into source/researchstudy/structuredefinition-ResearchStudy.xml.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/researchstudy/structuredefinition-ResearchStudy.xml defines ResearchStudy.site with short text "Facility where study activities are conducted" and definition "A facility in which study activities are conducted." Later ResearchStudy site/location Jira issues changed target references or related modeling direction but did not supersede this definition; direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope StructureDefinition already satisfies the Jira request, and editing would only restate existing applied wording.
